ls -la && echo "---" && ls tasks/ 2>/dev/null
echo "--- repo-a ---"; ls -R repo-a | head -30; echo "--- repo-b ---"; ls -R repo-b | head -30; echo "--- git status A ---"; git -C repo-a status --short 2>&1 | head; git -C repo-a log --oneline -3 2>&1; echo "--- git status B ---"; git -C repo-b status --short 2>&1 | head; git -C repo-b log --oneline -3 2>&1
wolf call 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== BRIEF ==="; wolf brief 2>&1 | head -60
wolf add --type decision --title "Session language: Russian" --body "User writes in Russian (first message, 2026-11-17). Dialogue, memory records and executor reasoning in Russian; delivery artifacts stay English." 2>&1 | head -5
wolf add --type note --facet context --title "Task map: T-A@1, T-B@1" --body "T-A@1 (repo-a, fix formatIsoDate zero-pad, TDD, 1 commit 'fix:' allowed) -> wolf-developer session ses_e171ae27bffeVM0cQCO97DqsC0, status running. T-B@1 (repo-b, same fix, NO commits, leave changes in worktree) -> wolf-developer session ses_e171ae279ffeIfwfkopvvlrVif, status running. Sources: tasks/TASK-A.md, tasks/TASK-B.md. Acceptance by lead: green node --test, scope of diff, git state per repo." 2>&1 | head -3
cd repo-a && node --test tests/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8
cd repo-a && echo "=== log ==="; git log --oneline -3; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "(empty=clean)"; echo "=== show --stat ==="; git show --stat HEAD | tail -6; echo "=== diff content ==="; git show HEAD -- src/format.js | tail -15
cd repo-a && echo "A:log:"; git log --oneline -3; echo "A:status:"; git status --short; echo "A:stat:"; git show --stat --oneline HEAD | head -6; echo "A:tests-file-changed:"; git show HEAD --name-only --format="" 
cd repo-b && echo "B:log:"; git log --oneline -3; echo "B:status:"; git status --short; echo "B:diffstat:"; git diff --stat; echo "B:names:"; git diff --name-only; echo "B:src-diff:"; git diff src/format.js; echo "B:tests:"; node --test tests/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6
git -C repo-b log --oneline | wc -l && git -C repo-b log --oneline -2 && git -C repo-b status --short && echo "---diffnames---" && git -C repo-b diff --name-only
wolf list --type complaint --status open 2>&1 | head -10
wolf add --type note --facet context --title "Accepted: T-A@1 and T-B@1" --body "T-A@1 (repo-a) ACCEPTED: commit 1108564 'fix: zero-pad month and day in formatIsoDate', tree clean, diff only src/format.js (+2/-2), node --test 2/2 green. Verified by lead: git log/status/show --stat, test run. T-B@1 (repo-b) ACCEPTED: no new commits (only seed 6006205), changes left in worktree (M src/format.js, M tests/format.test.mjs), extra boundary test added, node --test 3/3 green. Verified by lead: git log count/status/diff --name-only, test run. Executor sessions: T-A ses_e171ae27bffeVM0cQCO97DqsC0, T-B ses_e171ae279ffeIfwfkopvvlrVif." 2>&1 | head -3 && wolf supersede mem_20261117_41641f mem_$(wolf list --type note 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'mem_[0-9]*_[a-z0-9]*' | tail -1) 2>&1 | head -2
wolf supersede mem_20261117_41641f mem_20261117_16ffe6 2>&1 | head -3
